text: I'm so sorry to be messaging at this hour, I know you must be busy with more important things. I'm looking after my granddaughter tonight, she's only 5 months old, and she's come out in chickenpox spots, which her mum says are going round the baby group. They seem itchy, she keeps rubbing at them. I took her temperature and it's 38.4. Other than that she seems well in herself. I did check her neck because I always worry about that, and it's not stiff at all, she can look down at her feet when I hold them up. I just wanted to make sure 38.4 isn't too high for such a little one and that I'm doing the right things for her. Thank you so much for your time, and sorry again.
